structured.approach: I read both contracted inputs. feat.tasks gives TSK-07 as the Frontend task on ap_portal, and org.engineering_stack gives the stack, CI command and branches. The G9 hook does not allow shell commands in FE-01, so I checked the repository by reading its files. I read .git/HEAD, the main, dev and feature/story refs and the feature/story reflog. I also read CLAUDE.md, package.json, ci.mjs, the exports and VERSION in src/ap_portal/index.js, and tests/portal.test.js. I checked what I found against the step's tool view, which confirms write access and a clean tree. Then I rewrote task.repo_access.md in full. Every citation in it points to an input, the tool view, the brief, the shared memory or a repository file read in this session. I used no connector because the inputs and the repository files held every fact I needed.

claims.text: The Frontend task for FEAT-ZD-48600 is TSK-07 (STORY-07), which renders the overdue risk table in the ap_portal repository.
Repository ap_portal is available locally and the agent identity has write access; the git status is clean.
No repository needs to be created, because ap_portal already has history at commit ff761ee.
Branch feature/story was created from dev at ff761ee and is checked out.
Branches main and dev both point at commit ff761ee.
ap_portal uses no Databricks, other workspace or database.
The repository uses Node.js 22 (CommonJS, node:test), and its CI command is node ci.mjs.
CI passes only if coverage is >= 90 and there are no console.log or eval( lines and no line longer than 140 characters.
The repository rule is to keep existing public signatures and add new functions for new behaviour; branches are main, dev and feature/<story>.
The current version is 2.3.0 in both src/ap_portal/index.js and package.json.
The current exports are VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary; TSK-07 must not change LABELS, formatAmount or renderAgingSummary.
The files in TSK-07's budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js, and all of them exist.
Commit messages start with the story ID.

open_questions: RA-1 (non-blocking): The branch convention is feature/<story>, but the working branch is feature/story, not feature/STORY-07. Should it be renamed? Interim: use feature/story and start every commit message with STORY-07.
RA-2 (non-blocking): Shell commands are not allowed in FE-01, so git status and CI were not run in this step. Write access and the clean tree come from the step's tool view.
structured.summary: The ap_portal repository is available and the agent identity can write to it, so FE-01's outcome is met. Branch feature/story was created from dev at ff761ee and is checked out, and main and dev point at the same commit. No repository needs to be created, and no Databricks workspace or database is needed. CI runs with node ci.mjs and needs coverage of at least 90%, the static checks and no failing tests. The current version is 2.3.0, and all three files in TSK-07's budget exist. The ap_portal CLAUDE.md citation now resolves because the file was read in this step. There are two non-blocking open questions: the branch name, and that write access was taken from the tool view because no shell commands were allowed.
